name: Quantinuum
status: Completed a traditional IPO on Nasdaq, pricing at $60/share and raising $1.68 billion. Honeywell and Cambridge Quantum retain roughly 82% ownership post-IPO.

name: PsiQuantum
status: Closed a $1.5 billion Series E in May 2026, lifting its valuation to $10.5 billion. Remains venture-funded with no public listing announced.

name: Xanadu
status: SPAC merger with Crane Harbor Acquisition Corp closed; began trading on Nasdaq and the TSX on March 27, 2026, as the first publicly listed photonic quantum company.

name: Infleqtion
status: SPAC merger with Churchill Capital Corp X closed; began trading on the NYSE under INFQ on February 17, 2026, becoming the first publicly listed neutral-atom quantum company.

name: Horizon Quantum
status: SPAC merger with dMY Squared Technology Group closed; began trading on Nasdaq under HQ on March 20, 2026.

name: Pasqal
status: Completed its SPAC merger with Bleichroeder Acquisition Corp II; began trading on Nasdaq under PSQL on August 28, 2026, with ~$360M in cash. A Euronext Paris dual listing is planned to follow.

name: IQM Quantum Computers
status: SPAC merger with Real Asset Acquisition Corp closed; ADSs began trading on Nasdaq under IQMX on July 2, 2026, the first European quantum computing company on a major US exchange.

name: EigenQ
note: Quantum-resilient security & trusted infrastructure · defense focus
status: Announced a definitive business combination with Silicon Valley Acquisition Corp at an estimated $3 billion enterprise value, plus ~$45M committed financing announced Sept 2026. Closing expected Q4 2026, pending shareholder and regulatory approval.
